svg.title: G3 HW/SW development: integrated process map
svg.desc: Process map of phase G3 HW/SW development: DEV-01 Software development environment and guidelines (Software, after nothing); DEV-02 Tool classification and qualification (Joint, after DEV-01); DEV-03 Hardware safety requirements (Electrical & mechanical, after nothing); DEV-04 Electrical and safety-chain design (Electrical & mechanical, after DEV-03); DEV-05 Electrical and battery safety (Electrical & mechanical, after DEV-04); DEV-06 Qualification of safety components (Electrical & mechanical, after DEV-04); DEV-07 Hardware failure analysis and fault lists (Safety-related control, after DEV-04); DEV-08 Reliability data and PL calculation (Safety-related control, after DEV-06, DEV-07); DEV-09 Software safety requirements (Software, after nothing); DEV-10 Software architecture (Software, after DEV-09); DEV-11 Software safety analysis (Software, after DEV-10); DEV-12 Safety parameters and configuration data (Software, after DEV-10); DEV-13 Software unit design and implementation (Software, after DEV-01, DEV-11, DEV-12); DEV-14 Software unit verification (Software, after DEV-02, DEV-13); DEV-15 ML engineering of the locomotion policy (Machine learning, after DEV-10); DEV-16 Cybersecurity implementation and verification (Cybersecurity, after DEV-13); DEV-17 Qualification of software components (Joint, after DEV-10); DEV-18 Proven-in-use evaluation (Joint, after DEV-17); DEV-19 Update the hazard log and the safety case (Joint, after DEV-08, DEV-14, DEV-16).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: P3 HW/SW development: who does what, in what order
